cut_parts_meaning: Movable nesting units under PLAN_V1_1 section 3. Group cut holes exclude Scan artwork and Text. Exact degenerate open-path bounds remain explicit; no silent geometry inflation.

derivation.method: Agent visual review of four Inkscape-rendered contact pages, native SVG geometry comparison and original XML membership/layers, before any train/held-out split. Bounds from the unmodified published lbrn2-to-svg@0.5.3 on documented compatibility inputs; all exported vectors and image corners independently validated against native SVG. Source XML supplies layer state and top-level identity; GEOS supplies cut-hole topology. No Nestbolt importer used.
derivation.review_note: Grid has 32 axis-aligned open Paths, five circles and 50 Text objects. Fourteen contained labels attach to the smallest enclosing circle. Thirty-two exact bounds are degenerate: warn and require grouping or an explicit nonzero proxy before nesting; never silently drop them.
derivation.text_reference_caveat: Native-generated text caches are reference evidence only; original missing-cache state remains a warning.

expected_layout_failure: Axis-aligned open paths have zero-area bounds; group them with their intended part or explicitly choose a nonzero proxy. Never silently omit them.
